sentences.text: "1. Vakalatnama filed by Sri R.B. Pal, advocate on behalf of opposite party no.2 is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and perused the material available on record.
3.

Present Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant - Sunil Verma in Complaint Case No. 120 of 2019,
under Sections 376, 120-B I.P.C. Police Station- Biwanr, District- Hamirpur.
4.
The present applicant happens to be the Nandoi of the victim, who along with co-accused allegedly committed rape with her in her own house.
A criminal complaint was filed wherein summoning order was passed against the present applicant to face trial under Section 376 I.P.C. vide order dated 5.9.2019.

The said order was challenged by way of Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. No. 8189 of 2020 wherein vide order dated 28.02.2020 the matter was sent back for fresh consideration and subsequently in compliance of that order a fresh summoning order was passed by the Court concerned on 17.6.2022 and present applicant along with co-accused Ram Swaroop Verma was summoned to face the trial under Sections 376 and 120-B I.P.C. by the Court concerned.

It also appears that another Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. No. 23077 of 2023 was moved but without granting any protection the said application was disposed of by this Court vide order dated 20.07.2023.
5.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has no concern with the present matter.
Allegations levelled in the matter are general in nature.
Applicant's case is squarely covered under Section 438 Cr.P.C.

It is further submitted that as a matter of fact the victim of this case had a matrimonial dispute with her husband and a case under Section 498-A I.P.C. was also lodged by her against her in-laws and due to the animosity of that case the present applicant, who happened to be only Nandoi of the victim of the case has been implicated falsely in this case.

It is further submitted that the co-accused Ram Swaroop Verma, who was also the Nandoi of the victim, having identical role, has been granted interim protection by this Court vide order dated 16.11.2023 passed in Crl. Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 12516 of 2023.
It is further submitted that there is no medical report of the victim on record.
The applicant has no concern with the offence alleged.
He has no criminal antecedent.
He is cooperating with the trial and is entitled for anticipatory bail.
If the applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty and will cooperate with the investigation.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest by the police any time.
5. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer, but he could not dispute this fact that there is no medical report of the victim on record.

sentences.text: The matter requires consideration.
7. Opposite party no.2 may file counter affidavit within three weeks.

Learned A.G.A.
may also file counter affidavit within the same period.
Rejoinder affidavit may thereafter be filed within a week.
8. As an interim protection, till the next date of listing, the applicant is granted interim anticipatory bail in the aforesaid case.

In the event of arrest of the applicant,
he shall be released on interim anticipatory bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall make himself available before the Court concerned on the date fixed in the matter.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office.

(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by her before the S.S.P./S.P.
Concerned.
9. In case of default of any of the conditions, same may be a ground for cancellation of interim protection granted to the applicant.

10. List this case on 11.12.2023 before the appropriate Court."
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is brother-in-law of the complainant and has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
Matrimonial dispute exists between the complainant and her husband Pankaj Verma.
No medical report is available on record.
The allegations levelled against the applicant are vague and general.
The applicant is appearing before the trial court on the dates fixed.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
5. Learned Brief Holder for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

6. Having regard to the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as recorded in the order dated 22.11.2023, considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant and in particular the fact that a matrimonial dispute exists between the complainant and her husband Pankaj Verma, the fact that no medical report is available on record, the fact that no violation of conditions or misuse of liberty of bail has been pointed out by the learned A.G.A., without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
